content: tls-crypt (tls_crypt.c) wraps control-channel packets: HMAC-SHA256 computed over packet-id+plaintext, top 128 bits of tag used as AES-256-CTR IV, wire layout is [packet-id][HMAC-tag(32B)][ciphertext]. Static key file is OpenVPN 'Static key v1' format: 2048-bit (256-byte) key material, hex-encoded between BEGIN/END markers, split into 4x64-byte keys (encrypt-cipher, encrypt-hmac, decrypt-cipher, decrypt-hmac) assigned by direction.
